items.title: Epoch updates AI data center database; coverage of global AI compute estimated at 45%
items.summary_en: Epoch's AI data centers dataset gives independent estimates of power, compute and cost built from satellite imagery, permits and construction knowledge. As of 1 Oct 2026 it estimates its coverage of global deployed AI computing capacity at 45%, with a wide 90% interval of 24% to 83%.
items.notes: Search snippet only; epoch.ai blocked. 45% may conflict with the 53% figure in the 16 Sep item (different measure/date); not reconciled.

items.title: Epoch expands its database of biological AI models to 1,196 models
items.summary_en: Epoch released an expanded analysis and database of AI models in biology. Of 1,196 models, 1,124 were annotated with AI assistance only and 72 received dedicated manual annotation.
items.notes: Exact date unverified (search summary said 1-2 Oct). Mostly AI-assisted annotation is a quality caveat.

items.title: AI scores on Epoch's furniture assembly benchmark rise from 28% to 80% in ten months
items.summary_en: Epoch reports the frontier score went from 28% (Opus 4.5, Nov 2025) to 80% (Astra, Sep 2026). Open-weight models trail closed-weight models by about 7 months.
items.notes: Snippet only; before window (earlier-gap item). Epoch's own benchmark; real-world generalisation unverified.

items.title: Cost of reaching a given AI performance level falling about 13x per year
items.summary_en: Epoch estimates the price of a fixed level of AI performance has fallen about 47% per quarter since 2023 (roughly 13x per year), faster than DNA sequencing, compute and lithium batteries.
items.notes: Snippet only; earlier-gap item; methodology not reviewed.

items.title: GPT-6 Astra tops Epoch Capabilities Index but trails on software engineering
items.summary_en: Epoch's data insight reports GPT-6 Astra at 166 on the ECI, ahead of Claude Fable 5.1 (164) and GPT-5.6 Sol (162). Astra's Math-ECI of 170 is a record, while its SWE-ECI of 164 is below Fable 5.1's 167.
items.notes: Snippet only; earlier-gap item. 1-3 point gaps may be within uncertainty.

items.title: Epoch scales up AI data center research; captures about 53% of new 2026 compute
items.summary_en: Epoch says it has captured an estimated 53% of newly deployed compute so far in 2026, up from 39% in 2025 and 26% in 2024.
items.notes: Snippet only; earlier-gap item. See 45% note above.

items.title: Share of US adults using AI 6+ days a week rose from 8% to 19% (Mar to Aug 2026)
items.summary_en: According to Epoch AI and Ipsos polling, heavy weekly AI use among US adults rose from 8% in March 2026 to 19% in August 2026.
